result.reasoning_summary: FW-BME-01 implementation meets all deterministic security and design checks. Bounded schema: fixtures limited to 64KB total, 1KB per string, 32 max URLs, and 32 max indicators; the fixture-key allow-list is enforced. Source/event pairing is canonical. Tenant/time binding is exact. Authentication and indicator tokens enforce exact membership. BrowserEmailObservation is immutable and marked UNTRUSTED_DATA. All validation precedes Evidence and Evidence failures deny. Evidence logs counts rather than raw URLs or sender data. Prompt-injection content remains untrusted strings without interpretation. Code inspection confirms no prohibited authority. Focused 11 tests and git diff --check passed.
